sources.frequency_ghz,core_counts,capacity,buffe: CANN 9.2.1 aarch64-linux/data/platform_config/Ascend950DT_9582.ini, SHA256 b8e7d61780056889e795639504530ecacb2b759ad1602e929b863d837fdf0099. Capacity in decimal GB computed from memory_size bytes.
sources.cube_tops,vector_tops: Huawei 950 NPU architecture white paper table 3-1, matched by core count. Cube 16=BF16/FP16, 8=FP8/INT8, 4=MXFP4. Vector 32=FP32, 16=FP16/BF16, 8=INT8. Unquoted formats are unknown (null). TF32 is distinct from strict FP32.
sources.hbm_bandwidth_gbs: DT family peak, white paper table 3-1, GB/s decimal.
sources.details.rms_output_retained_fraction: Scenario assumption. Dirty RMS outputs may remain in available L2 at kernel retirement. No direct writeback counter. Use 0 for forced external drain; 1 is capped by target spare L2 after active input buffers.
sources.details.quant_*: v0.19 stage calibration from archived Ascend950DT_9582 official CA (results/v0.19/quant-dma-samples.json and development/validation/sku19/quant_prices.py). Earliest payload issue conditioned on single tile vs pipelined, response cycles and SIMD entry/exit clocks. quant_loop_work_ops is the common DT stage slope converted to peak-equivalent operations. These prices also include simulator dispatch behaviour.
